dataset.identity: six-digit code required; market/full instrument identity never guessed
dataset.duplicatePolicy: reject code/date duplicates, never deduplicate silently
dataset.legacyBridge: native/tests/quant_research_legacy_bridge.py explicitly reads verified existing manifest/parquet, outputs a new package outside source directory; no runtime install/network/production writes
dataset.conversionLimitation: embedded old file hashes are verified; parquet-to-bars conversion is not independently parsed on native device

config.parameters: 1-64 explicit unique-ID combinations; settings retain legacy family parameter names
config.windows: trainDays 63-2520, validationDays 21-504, testDays/stepDays 21-252, step >= test; maxFolds 3-12; minimumHistoryDays 20-504
config.selection: retain last maxFolds; purge=1; validation-only parameter selection by return, drawdown, trade count, ID; non-overlapping test windows
config.liquidity: first retained fold training history coverage descending, median volume descending, code ascending
config.simulation: close signal, next available row open; T+1; 100-share lot; 10% rounded price limits; zero-volume suspension; pending exit retained across blocked days
config.valuation: window-end estimate includes hypothetical exit fee/tax/slippage; unclosed holdings retained; max drawdown matches legacy per-symbol minimum, not aggregate equity curve
config.claim: always exploratory, automaticTrading=false; no trained LightGBM/MASTER or online AI claim

archive.preservation: exact original UTF-8 text and actual-byte SHA256, all unknown fields retained
archive.claim: archived-original-only-no-artifact-verification; reading a validated field does not validate attachments, reproduce model or establish scientific validity

store.writes: independent atomic JSON + lock; dataset/archive immutable; job updates use full baseline CAS, frozen config/dataset/materials
store.draft: independent view file, full baseline CAS; corrupt view does not auto-overwrite; explicit reread restores readable state
store.restart: never auto-resume/retrain; pending old jobs can be explicitly marked interrupted
store.backup: preview then atomic merge, stale preview rejects, same ID different content rejects; full original datasets/runs/evidence/material snapshots included

materials: immutable namespace/kind/id/fingerprint/originalRecord descriptors verified by existing PersonMethod pure contract; source callback receives exact frozen version
reader: 24000-character/codepoint pages with complete underlying text and full export
acceptance: dedicated Qt/Java/actual legacy Python checks separate from root hosted UI/device checks; 5564 is emulator, no ARM acceptance inferred
